assistant_text:
The current model cannot distinguish two options reliably, so no option can be put forward. That uncertainty is the finding—not a basis for choosing between them.

The comparison rests on 18 values supplied by Olumi, not you; the material assumptions have not been validated. The reported support shares are not chances of reaching your target of at least £24,000/month within nine months.

This result supplies no confirmed goal chances. Carrying on holds today’s recorded values, but its goal outcome was withheld. Sensitivity and tipping points were not measured.

‘Loyalty App’: between less than 1% and 5% chance of meeting your goal, in this model. It depends most on how strongly ‘Loyalty app active’ affects ‘Loyalty-driven monthly gross profit’, which isn’t sized in the model yet. ‘Fourth Shop in Clifton’: between about 6% and 56% chance of meeting your goal, in this model. It depends most on how strongly ‘Fourth shop active’ affects ‘Fourth-shop monthly operating profit’, which isn’t sized in the model yet. ‘Office Bean Wholesale’: between about 5% and 55% chance of meeting your goal, in this model. Of the links not sized yet, it depends most on how strongly ‘Wholesale channel active’ affects ‘Wholesale monthly gross profit’, which isn’t sized in the model yet.

I supplied 18 of the values behind this, because your brief did not state them. They are mine rather than yours. Changing any of them changes what this model implies. 2 options came out too close together on this run to tell apart, so the order between them reflects this draw rather than your model, and no option can be put forward yet. Tell me what matters most to you between them and I will work from that.

provisional_view.reasoning: Your brief states costs and a profit target, but not the additional profit each activity could generate. The comparison therefore relies on Olumi-supplied values, and this run does not reliably separate the options.
provisional_view.confirm_step: Build an evidence-backed month-nine profit forecast for each activity, separating gross profit, recurring costs and the treatment of fit-out spending, to check the model’s assumptions.
